title: A picked cut opens from a chevron on its track header, as the transition mock draws it
goal: In the transition walkthrough the cut opens into its two clips from a small chevron on the V1 track label. Today it opens from its right-click, the Clip menu and Option E, but the header has no control for it, because the arrow already on the header opens the track keyed-value lanes. Decide with the user how the header offers it, then build that.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transition-wt.html line 376 #btnExpand (.xbtn chevron-down in the V1 .tl), step 5 data-cue #btnExpand. Today: TimelineTrackRows.swift twist (hasKeyLanes / hasParts arrow). Expand the Cut itself shipped in a-cut-opens-into-its-two-clips-on-their-own-rows (EditorState+ExpandedCut.toggleExpandedCut, ExpandedCutRows). Walk to extend: Scripts/playtest/expand-the-cut-from-its-menus-walk.json.
acceptance: The user has answered the decision card on how the track header opens a picked cut
With a cut picked, the header control the user chose opens and closes the A and B rows, and the existing arrow still opens the key lanes
A walk at Next defaults clicks that control at a point on its face and measures the rows open, then closed
